objective: Implement MIB-13 Economy and Trade Deterministic Engine: currencies, price/modifier pipeline, merchant/service availability, buy/sell/barter/trade validation, reservation/contract/settlement receipts and deterministic market fixtures while preserving inventory/economy authority and excluding real-money commerce. The engine must expose safe owner-domain economy operations that existing Downtime/APW and Cozy/APM orchestration can consume later without granting those layers new authority. Economic scope must be scale-independent and support independent nested/connected markets from local settlements through continents, worlds, multi-world systems and multiple realities; meaningful price/availability differences must create legitimate player-facing trade opportunities when movement costs and constraints still leave positive value.

application_baseline.rule: Reuse MIB-03 deterministic runtime, MIB-05 governed content, MIB-06 fixtures, MIB-07 Workbench, MIB-08 integrity tooling and MIB-12 crafting outputs/owner receipts. Repository inventory found no existing dedicated in-game balance/account owner, so MIB-13 may define a provider-neutral owner port but may not invent a durable wallet ledger or persistence provider. Reuse existing APW Downtime/Project and APM Cozy contracts as integration consumers only; do not move economy authority into those orchestration layers. Do not reserve migration 0022 without a demonstrated durable economy-state delta.

integration_requirements: Provide authorization-safe price/value and merchant/service availability projections suitable for Downtime/Cozy previews.
Provide version-safe in-game currency/material budget and cost summaries without granting APM automation authority.
Expose buy sell barter trade and service-contract operations through stable owner-domain command/receipt seams that APW/APM can call when separately authorized.
Provide deterministic status/recovery lookup so bounded Cozy/Downtime execution cannot duplicate settlements after retries or ambiguous responses.
Preserve a no-AI deterministic path and keep real-money/payment integration absent.
Do not implement the later CEL life-loop, market cadence or automation controller inside MIB-13; only provide the economy primitives/interfaces CEL will consume.
economic_scope_requirements: Represent economy/market scopes as stable versioned definitions that can nest or connect without creating separate engines for local, continental, planetary, inter-world or cross-reality play.
Reference MIB-11/world-location identities for geography/reality scope instead of inventing a second world or reality hierarchy.
Support inherited defaults plus explicit local overrides for currency acceptance, prices, availability, scarcity, legality, taxes/tariffs and service access.
Support explicit trade links/routes between scopes, including disconnected, closed, embargoed or conditionally accessible links.

Cross-scope valuation and settlement may include deterministic currency conversion, transport/transfer cost, tariffs/taxes, legality, capacity, route access, delivery constraints, risk premiums, spoilage/perishability inputs where authored, and other governed modifiers.
Version-check every scope/link/quote input used for settlement so stale market state fails closed rather than silently settling at obsolete terms.
market_opportunity_requirements: Independent markets may intentionally have different supply, demand, scarcity, price and availability profiles; the engine must preserve those differences instead of flattening them into one global price.

Provide deterministic comparison/quote seams that can reveal profitable movement opportunities between authorized markets when buy price plus all explicit movement/transaction costs is lower than the reachable sell value.

Profit is never guaranteed: transport/transfer cost, tariffs, taxes, spoilage, danger/risk premiums, capacity, legality, route access, merchant limits, changing versions and other authored constraints can narrow or erase an opportunity.

Do not implement an autonomous market-simulation loop in MIB-13; expose deterministic market state, quote, route-cost and settlement primitives so later CEL/Downtime/game systems can turn trading into consequential play.

Acceptance fixtures must include at least one genuinely profitable local-to-remote trade route, one route whose apparent spread is erased by costs/constraints, and one unavailable/embargoed/disconnected route that fails closed.

planned_consumers.use: ingredient crop livestock creature-harvest prepared-food alchemical and production valuation/trade metadata
Cozy/Downtime goals budgets orders demand trade reinvestment and bounded life-loop orchestration

completion_gate: Deterministic in-game economic transactions are version-safe, replay-safe, attributable and cannot duplicate settlement; nested/connected economic scopes work from local through cross-reality scales without a second engine; independent markets preserve meaningful local price/availability differences and can yield real player-facing trade opportunities when all governed movement and transaction costs still permit profit; stale/blocked/disconnected routes fail closed; inventory/economy authority boundaries remain explicit; safe APW/APM consumer seams exist for price/availability/cost/settlement/status without shifting authority into Cozy or Downtime; no real-money/payment integration, autonomous market simulation, or production provider dependency is introduced; exact-head repository health plus self-hosted Windows/Linux and deterministic comparison pass before merge.

autonomous market/life simulation beyond the selected MIB-13 primitives
